title: gj-scenegraph: research handbook (RESOURCES.md + SKILLS.md)
summary: First task before any ticket (kit §3 common block): research the top 100 resources on indoor scene understanding, affordance detection, 3D Gaussian segmentation (Gaussian Grouping lineage), reachability and route search, VR-GS / DecoupledGaussian / 2026 scene-level physics papers, climbing and parkour system design; save an annotated list and distill a working handbook. Re-read SKILLS.md at every session start and update it when you learn something.

acceptance_tests.test: projects/skills/scenegraph/RESOURCES.md lists at least 100 resources, each with title, URL, type (doc / paper / talk / repo / postmortem / vendor guide), and a one-line 'why it matters for GJ', grouped by the role's research focus.
acceptance_tests.evidence: file in PR; Coordinator counts entries

acceptance_tests.test: projects/skills/scenegraph/SKILLS.md covers: mesh cleanup, surface classification per Bible §4, traversal graph and validator (Bible §10 contract), summit/route/vista generation, Tier 1 pipeline, Tier 2 research method; plus mistakes to avoid and the checklists you run before opening a PR.
